reasons: touches security, isolation, or authority verification boundary

stopping_conditions.continuation_policy: At most six failed executions per task across steps/output directories and at most three with one defect signature; only explicit task-scoped finite operator recovery can reopen a budget. Narratives, amendments, decomposition labels and successful unrelated checks do not reset failures.
stopping_conditions.halt_condition: Stop and escalate on exhausted task/step failure budgets, three identical task-wide failures, contradiction with approved contract/invariants, missing operator authority, or exhausted execution budget/step limit; comparator claims remain subordinate to stopping rules.
stopping_conditions.pass_condition: All required_gates for route 'high-risk' exit 0 and blocking verdict arrays are empty.
